The '''''Night Gyre''''' was a [[Z-95 Headhunter/Legends|Z-95 Headhunter]] that was used by the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Darrus Jeht/Legends|Darrus Jeht]] during the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. It was purchased by the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] via the [[Almas Academy]] and assigned to Jeht while he was a student, becoming his first [[Starship/Legends|starship]]. The craft suffered from a sensor ghost as a result of an encounter that it had had with an [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]].
